# standard-release-engineering

<!-- generated by standards.py from projectious-work/standards; do not edit -->

Binding company standard. The rules below are the summary; the linked file is authoritative. Read only the section the task needs.

## Software verification and release-engineering standard

Verify a release branch before its squash merge and tag the squash commit.
Select checks by product profile and change risk, verify exact candidate
artifacts, and independently verify what was published.

Full standard: `.standards/software-verification-and-release-engineering.md`. Sections:

- Purpose and relationship to branching
- Release identity and chain of custody
- Test layers
- Verification gates
- Implementation integrity
- Regression, isolation, and reliability
- Release artifacts and provenance
- Release record

## Human-controlled host-phase execution standard

Prepare immutable candidates in the restricted environment, cross the host
boundary through a portable versioned handover, validate without credentials,
and publish only from finalized evidence under the *Principle of Least
Privilege*.

Full standard: `.standards/human-controlled-host-phase-execution.md`. Sections:

- Purpose and applicability
- Normative security boundary
- Producer/verifier protocol
- Lifecycle and storage classes
- Bootstrap and executable resolution
- Capability adapters
- Validation and publication
- Operator contract
- Coverage, vulnerabilities, and caches
- Conformance

## Host-gated release conformance

Implementations of host-phase execution pass every applicable mandatory case
group (handover and lifecycle, bootstrap, adapters, coverage, vulnerabilities
and caches, publication and cleanup, operator presentation, dry-run). Record
candidate identity, platform, adapter, outcome, evidence paths, and a reason
for every skip. Negative cases pass only when the gate refuses safely with
the expected failure evidence.

Full standard: `.standards/host-gated-release-conformance.md`. Sections:

- Purpose
- Mandatory case groups
- Reference profiles
